title: Browns bump rookies Spencer Fano, Denzel Boston up to the first team

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Browns bump rookies Spencer Fano, Denzel Boston up to the first team
sources.description: Browns rookie offensive tackle Spencer Fano got into a scuffle with defensive end Jared Verse at training camp on Saturday and it earned him something much better than a reprimand from head coach Todd Monken.
